name: Dire Maul: Zevrim Thornhoof's Sacrifice drains its target every second
contract: The tooltip of the Ascension Sacrifice 2100215 reads that the target suffers 17% maximum health damage per
second. Its linked drain 2100216 is a periodic percent-damage aura (effect 1, aura 89) whose DBC amplitude is
2000 ms in both the server and the game client, so it ticked every two seconds. The server now ticks it every
1000 ms. Zevrim 11490 is summoned beside a level-57 player in Dire Maul and casts Sacrifice on it. The drain's
effect 1 must report a 1000 ms periodic interval, and the player must take at least five drain ticks from
Zevrim within six seconds: the 8 second aura can reach only four ticks at the old two-second interval. A health
fixture keeps the player alive through five ticks.

steps.label: Let the character finish logging in
SETUP: victim is inside the dungeon
Summon the boss in the victim's instance
Let the boss's spawn events settle
Zevrim casts the Ascension Sacrifice on the victim
SETUP: Sacrifice links its periodic drain
DISCRIMINATING: five drain ticks land within six seconds
